notes.title: 0.8.9b update: controls and convenience
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35020444/b85019ab4ce68b41fe915873186c8419bab644dd.jpg[/img][list]
[*][b] Buttons guide added[/b]
[*] [b]Directional teleport[/b] — teleport system can modify playarea orientation
[*] [b]Car respawn[/b] — car can be easily reset, if out of reach or turned over
[*][b] Input improvements[/b] — no need to click to use teleport, "X" button can be used for reverse (Oculus only)
[/list]
